claims.claim: All supported self-host workflows now materialize a clean transient control checkout bound to the invocation's exact published main SHA, keep it distinct from AIOS_REPO_ROOT, and fail closed before AIOS invocation when provenance cannot be proven.

The thin repository-owned control entry loads the existing Operator through process-local import resolution, exports no control-source import override, and adds no lifecycle, Runtime, Git-integration, or Executor-selection authority.
Production-shaped regression coverage proves trusted control behavior wins over poisoned persistent candidate source while preserving the candidate HEAD and worktree.
Operational Receipt v2 supports exact control_sha attribution and bounded PRE_AIOS control-source failures without asserting RUN creation or Executor invocation.
Direct local CLI behavior remains available, the four-subject boundary and steady-state provenance are documented, and all changes remain within the authorized scope.
